senses.definition: (Australia, New Zealand) A tin with a swing handle used to boil tea over an open fire; a billycan; a billypot.
examples: Let's get the billy and cook some beans.

quotes.text: We had been absent from civilisation, so long, that our tin billies, the only boiling utensils we had, got completely worn or burnt out at the bottoms, and as the boilings for glue and oil must still go on, what were we to do with billies with no bottoms?
